crossRefs.note: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or…
then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of…
If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and…
when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’…

people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there. Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom he had spoken came along, and Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.
translations.kjv: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.
translations.asv: Now Boaz went up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.
